title: Rewrite History - Delete and reupload to Nightscout
symptom: The Re-write history option is awesome, it would be cool if this could extend to the Nightscout Uploader. So upon calibration, xdrip will delete all the re-calibrated records in the Nightscout Database and reupload the new re-calibrated values (so the graph will be smooth upon calibration). That way it would prevent the Nightscout graphs from jumping when a CGM Calibration as been applied and it gives better data back to closed loopers for Autotune.
evidence_quote: Rewrite history is a graphics setting. None of the graphics settings affect Nightscout. Neither should this one.
